name: A blade and its question
summary: Yet the new axe stands in Frostmourne's shadow. It, too, was fed by the souls of fallen foes; it bears the power of saronite and fragments taken from the Frozen Throne. The chain raises a fear it does not settle: whether this weapon can resist the same doom as Frostmourne. No certainty is offered. Its wielder goes forward bearing both a blade and a question.
